business: Tata Power Company Ltd is an integrated power company engaged in power generation, transmission, distribution, renewable energy (including solar manufacturing and rooftop installations), and newer areas like pumped hydro and hydro projects. Its main segments include power transmission, distribution, generation, and renewable energy clusters.
